messages:
Cass (Marketing): quick creative brief  we need a 'mosaic benchkit' for the launch: hero visual (web + print), interactive webinar slide (data + callout), single-sheet PDF, 4 social tiles (square + vertical), email header, and an SVG inbound-routing map for HubSpot. Go-live: Tue EOD (2026-04-07). Who can pick this up?

Omar (Design): I can take it. curious if the webinar slide should be an animated/exportable GIF or a static PDF? and which exact metrics to surface?

Cass (Marketing): static PDF for slide deck + a GIF version for the webinar intro if you can. metrics: p50/p95 latency and cost per 1k tokens. short headlines only. will add final copy to Drive.

Ben (Product): uploaded numbers: p50=37ms, p95=108ms, cost=$0.0068/1k tokens. also added a short note: "measured on internal testbeds; not an SLA." Drive link in channel.

Zoe (Marketing Ops): for HubSpot SVG please include labeled element ids (id=form-email id=seg-webinar id=sfdc_source). I'll provide a mapping CSV once IDs exist. Also need an accessible alt-text file for the social tiles.

Legal (Legal): compliance note: do not publish customer logos without explicit written consent. partner logos on the approved whitelist are ok. avoid absolute claims; use qualifiers like "benchmarked" or "measured in our testbeds."

Omar (Design): timeline: WIP Mon 09:00 PT (hero + webinar slide first), final Tue 13:00 PT. file specs: hero web 1400x800 PNG, hero print 8.5x11 PDF, webinar slide PDF + GIF 1920x1080, 1-pager PDF letter, social 1200x1200 + 1080x1920, email header 600x200, SVG with ids. will deliver EN masters with editable text layers for FR/DE.

Cass (Marketing): perfect  include a master SVG for Zoe with element ids. i'll run a brand sweep on the WIP. tag me when uploads ready.

Omar (Design): will upload to Drive and tag @Cass when WIP ready. ping here for copy changes.

Zoe (Marketing Ops): once SVG is uploaded i'll prepare the HubSpot mapping CSV and alt-text sheet.

Cass (Marketing): thanks team  please keep the wording consistent with Ben's README.
